an10.212:1.1: “Bhikkhus, possessing ten qualities, one is deposited in hell as if brought there.
an10.212:1.3: (1) “Here, someone destroys life; he is murderous, bloody-handed, given to blows and violence, merciless to living beings.
an10.212:2.1: (2) He takes what is not given …
an10.212:2.8: (9) He has a mind of ill will and intentions of hate …
an10.212:2.9: (10) He holds wrong view and has an incorrect perspective thus:
an10.212:2.10: ‘There is nothing given … there are in the world no ascetics and brahmins of right conduct and right practice who,
an10.212:2.11: having realized this world and the other world for themselves by direct knowledge, make them known to others.’
an10.212:2.12: One possessing these ten qualities is deposited in hell as if brought there.
an10.212:3.1: “Bhikkhus, one possessing ten qualities is deposited in heaven as if brought there.
an10.212:3.3: (1)“Here, someone, having abandoned the destruction of life, abstains from the destruction of life; with the rod and weapon laid aside, conscientious and kindly, he dwells compassionate toward all living beings.
an10.212:4.1: (2) Having abandoned the taking of what is not given, he abstains from taking what is not given …
an10.212:4.2: (3) Having abandoned sexual misconduct, he abstains from sexual misconduct …
an10.212:4.3: (4) Having abandoned false speech, he abstains from false speech …
an10.212:4.4: (5) Having abandoned divisive speech, he abstains from divisive speech …
an10.212:4.5: (6) Having abandoned harsh speech, he abstains from harsh speech …
an10.212:4.6: (7) Having abandoned idle chatter, he abstains from idle chatter …
an10.212:4.9: (10) He holds right view and has a correct perspective thus: ‘There is what is given … there are in the world ascetics and brahmins of right conduct and right practice who,
an10.212:4.10: having realized this world and the other world for themselves by direct knowledge, make them known to others.’
an10.212:4.11: One possessing these ten qualities is deposited in heaven as if brought there.”
